definitions: To leave one's home to attend one's job or place of employment.
To begin to perform one's job or duties.
To begin to operate or function effectively.
To apply oneself diligently to a task.
examples: I go to work at 8 AM every day.
The new machine will go to work tomorrow.
Let's go to work on this project.
He needs to go to work if he wants to finish on time.
pastTenses: went to work, gone to work
